dash.title: My farm
dash.sub: Your stubble, offers from buyers and orders.
dash.offersHint: A buyer wants your stubble. Open it to accept, reject or ask for a better price.
dash.listingsEmpty: You have not listed any stubble yet
dash.listingsEmptyHint: List your stubble and buyers near you will send offers.
dash.ordersEmptyHint: When you accept an offer, the order shows here.
dash.offersEmptyHint: When a buyer sends an offer on your stubble, it shows here.

new.title: List stubble
new.sub: Tell buyers what you have. It takes 2 minutes.
new.tonnesHint: A tractor trolley holds about 2 to 3 tonnes of bales.
new.moistureHint: Leave empty if you don't know.
new.notesHint: Any language is fine. For example: field is next to the main road.
new.priceNeedPlace: Choose your state and district first to see a fair price.
new.bandNoBuyer: No buyer registered near you yet
new.bandError: Could not load the fair price. You can still set your own price.
new.photosOff: Photo upload works only on the live site. You can list without photos.
new.photosHint: Up to 4 photos. JPG, PNG or WebP, max 5 MB each.
new.photoTooBig: This photo is bigger than 5 MB. Please choose a smaller one.
new.photoBadType: Please choose a JPG, PNG or WebP photo.
new.photoFailed: Photo upload failed. Please try again.
new.needPlace: Please choose your state and district, or tap "Use my location".
new.created: Listed! Our team will check it soon. Buyers can see it after approval.

listing.missing: This listing was not found in your account.
listing.pending: Waiting for approval. Our team checks every listing before buyers can see it.
listing.rejected: This listing was not approved. Please write to us from the Help page.
listing.closedNote: This listing is closed. Buyers cannot see it.
listing.editTonnesHint: Already sold: {sold}. Total cannot be less than that.
listing.closeConfirm: Close this listing? Buyers will not see it any more.
listing.offersEmptyHint: Buyers will send offers once your listing is live.
listing.acceptConfirm: Sell {tonnes} to {buyer} at {price}? An order will be made.
listing.counterSent: Your price was sent. Waiting for the buyer.
listing.accepted: Offer accepted. An order was made and we are finding a transporter.
